key_insight: A query-only LLM auditor closely reproduced clinical prediction models and detected 96% of planted flaws, but its additional warnings and discoveries required independent validation.
engineering_relevance: Black-box model audits can use LLM-generated probes and surrogate models, provided warnings are checked against model behavior and discoveries against held-out data.
method: Trained four model types on International Stroke Trial data for two clinical outcomes.
Mixed 24 models with planted flaws and 8 clean models; GPT-6 Astra audited each three times using prediction queries alone.
Scored audits programmatically with precommitted rules and tested unexpected relationships in later-randomized patients.
evidence_signal: Surrogates achieved mean log-odds R² of 0.976, and the auditor found 69/72 planted flaws across runs; a purpose-written script found all 24 distinct flaws.
watch_item: Beyond planted flaws, 60% of checkable problem reports failed the prespecified check, and only 11% of unexpected relationships held in later patients.
paper_title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
